description:
Search the Papyras product catalog using hybrid structured +
    semantic search. Pass `query` for free-text/natural-language
    search -- longer, natural phrases (e.g. "pressure washer for
    patio") retrieve more accurately than bare single words (e.g.
    "patio"), since the embedding model has more context to place
    the query vector precisely. Combine with structured filters
    (category, brand, price range, intent_tag, use_case_tag,
    audience_tag) to narrow results further.

    Defaults to showing only in_stock products. Pass
    availability="all" to see every status, or a specific value
    (in_stock | out_of_stock | preorder | discontinued) to filter to
    just that one.

    Returns a dict with `results` (list of product summaries
    including name, price, affiliate_url, tags, and a short
    explanation of why the product is relevant), plus `count`,
    `limit`, `offset`, and whether semantic search was actually used.
name: search_products
